x-behavior.backgroundRefresh: normal online mode may launch one locked native worker, Codex account and audited helper refresh; --read-only/--offline never launch
x-behavior.credentials: foreground is cache/local records; detached admitted readers use provider-owned sign-ins
x-behavior.network: background only when online and not read-only
x-behavior.writes: normal records local derived history; read-only writes nothing
x-behavior.floor: provider attempt floor >=5 minutes; provider-specific budgets/backoff can be longer; first no-attempt read is immediately due
x-behavior.keychain: background native reader policy is non-interactive and bounded to about 2 seconds
x-behavior.displayText: Notes/names are display; source IDs, states, booleans and numeric observations are machine values. Native sources.errorCode, their failure reason, and native connections.quota.reason use sanitised machine failure codes.

description: Desktop snapshot. Normal polls may schedule admitted readers; read-only does not collect.
